dslRule:
<!id: fix.varargs.array.warning>
<!description: Explicitly cast an array to Object[] when it is the last argument passed to a varargs method to fix a compiler warning regarding ambiguous varargs usage.
This ensures the array itself is treated as the varargs parameter, not that its elements are extracted into individual arguments.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$receiver.$method($args$, $arrayExpr) :: instanceof($arrayExpr, "java.lang.Object[]")
=> $receiver.$method($args$, (java.lang.Object[]) $arrayExpr)
;;
summary: Adds an explicit `(Object[])` cast to an array expression when it is the final argument of a method call that uses `Object...` varargs, resolving potential compiler warnings.
